shared_elements: an ambiguous animal- or bird-like form in profile (painted in A, carved in B)
natural stone as the support surface
justification: The only possible correspondence is that both surfaces carry a shape readable as a creature in profile on bare stone, and even that is uncertain in A, whose red-pigment blob has no reliably identifiable outline. Otherwise they are opposites: A is a single isolated painted stain on a rough grey boulder, while B is a deeply carved, multi-register relief with a horizontal patterned band and several clearly delineated animals stacked in an ordered composition.
